answer_1.quote: We benchmark thirteen LLMs, encompassing both closed-source and open-source models of varying sizes... Code Generation ... We introduce ELABORATIONSET, a novel programming dataset specifically designed for human-LLM collaboration.
answer_1.outputs: Generated code solutions for competitive programming problems

answer_2.quote: we utilize the Pass@k (k=1,3,5) metric (Chen et al., 2021) to evaluate overall performance, with Pass@1 holding particular importance due to its relevance to real-world applications.

answer_4.quote: Our experiments also incorporate real human participants to gain practical insights. We involve five computer science graduate students collaboratively solving competitive programming problems with LLMs.
answer_4.guideline: Human participants provided textual feedback, identified bugs, and interacted with the LLM across multiple turns.
